text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-849271 — inference.high_latency (region: eu-west-1)
incident-bot: Trigger: embeddings queue median latency > 2s for 3m, breach threshold. Auto-escalation enabled.

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: PD-849271 assigned to rotation -> maria_g
maria_g: grabbing this, acked in PD. Starting triage.
kevin_o: ping — joining. I'll pull autoscaler + queue metrics.
sara_oncall: hopping on the thread, starting a bridge in case we need to talk: https://zoom.redwood/xyz (will update)
ops_lead: customer-impact slack note: some customers seeing slow embeddings (~2-5s extra), not full errors yet. Throttle spike in eu-west-1.

maria_g: quick check: k8s queues show steady enqueue, but consumer pod CPU spiking on batcher-2.
kevin_o: logs: ```
batcher-2 | 2026-03-17T13:07:11Z WARN kvcache miss rate 0.42
batcher-2 | 2026-03-17T13:07:12Z ERROR retry_backoff exceeded for request_id=abc123
```
kevin_o: looks like batcher-2 is falling behind causing higher p99. Scaling didn't kick due to a cooldown bug.

sara_oncall: can we spin a replacement pod and drain batcher-2? If it's unhealthy, restart might clear.
maria_g: doing a rolling restart of batcher-2 now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/batcher-2 -n inference-eu`

incident-bot: Action logged: rolling-restart initiated by maria_g
ops_lead: noted. Posting customer-facing status: "We are investigating increased latency for embeddings in eu-west-1. Small subset of requests may be slower than usual. Engineers are actively mitigating."

kevin_o: new pod came up, CPU back to normal on new replica, queue drain speed improved. p50/p90 improving.
maria_g: confirming metrics: embeddings queue length down from 820 -> 120 in 3m. p99 latency falling from 3.2s -> 1.1s.
sara_oncall: thanks — can we stick a short postmortem note in incidents channel after resolution? ops_lead to write customer follow-up.

maria_g: handing off ownership to kevin_o for post-incident checks and follow-up (I remain available). Handoff timestamp: 2026-03-17T13:11Z. :white_check_mark:
kevin_o: accepted handoff. I'll run a full check on autoscaler cooldown and add a safe guard to avoid missed scale-ups.
ops_lead: customer notif drafted and scheduled. No major data loss, just latency; classified P2.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-849271 marked resolved by maria_g at 2026-03-17T13:12:30Z
incident-bot: Closing note: short routing bug + pod degradation; mitigation: rolling restart and autoscaler cooldown fix queued.

maria_g: marking thread resolved, will add short timeline to the incident doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin_o: will follow up with patch and postmortem items.
sara_oncall: nice quick remediation.
ops_lead: closing customer loop in 30m.
